title: Niagara Falls Premium Night Tour: Fireworks Boat Cruise & Dinner
includes: Toronto Central Meeting Point Pick-up and Drop-off (If option is selected)
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Niagara Falls Canada or USA (If option is selected)
Niagara City Cruises Fireworks Boat Ride (Admission Included)
"I Lit Up Niagara Falls" commemorative certificate
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your night begins with your tour guide picking you up from any downtown Niagara Falls, Canada location in a Mercedes Metris van.

Settle in at a local restaurant right near Horseshoe Falls for a 3-course dinner.

Once you are finished with your meal, you will head to your next thrilling experience - the Niagara Falls Fireworks Boat Cruise. Hop aboard this cruise and be in awe of the view of the Falls, while enjoying a beautiful fireworks show over the water.

After your incredible cruise, you will make your way to the Illumination Tower. As an added bonus, our guests then have the opportunity to get creative and control the lights themselves! You will then be presented with an “I Lit Up Niagara Falls” certificate as a keepsake from this exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Lastly, your tour guide will offer complimentary drop-off at any downtown Niagara Falls, Canada location.
